page.overview:
Who is Beleg of Arthedain?

Beleg was the son and heir of King Amlaith of Arthedain, and became king after his father's death in TA 946. During his reign, Hobbits were first seen west of the Misty Mountains, entering Eriador, largely composed of Harfoots. Also during his reign Sauron returned to the western lands, taking up residence at Dol Guldur as the 'Necromancer'.

Beleg died in TA 1029 at the age of two-hundred and eighteen, after ruling for eighty-three years. He was succeeded by his son Mallor.

He shares a name with Beleg Cúthalion, the famous Sindarin bowman of Doriath and friend of Túrin Turambar. The name means 'mighty'.
